notes: Researched list of offsite / industrialized construction events. Dates checked against organizer pages where available; items marked unconfirmed come from secondary listings and are imported as Pending.

events.title: Boston Built Week 2026
events.description: A city-wide week of independently hosted events on building, construction technology and development across Boston. CfOC lists selected events below.

events.title: BT Industry Social, Boston
events.description: An evening gathering for architecture, engineering and construction professionals in Massachusetts. Part of Boston Built Week 2026.

events.title: CalBEM 2026 Symposium
events.description: A two-day in-person symposium for California building energy modeling research, practical modeling insights, and industry and policy developments.

events.title: Vermont Development Conference 2026
events.description: Vermont's annual conference for developers, planners, architects, lenders and policymakers on housing, infrastructure and getting projects built.

events.title: The Future of Construction Technology (panel)
events.organizer: City of Boston Housing Innovation Lab with ULI Boston
events.description: Evening panel (5–7 pm) on how new construction technology, including offsite and modular methods, can speed up housing delivery. Part of Boston Built Week 2026.

events.title: VHFA Statewide Housing Conference 2026
events.description: Vermont's largest biennial affordable housing conference, with sessions on development, financing and housing policy.

events.title: BuiltWorlds AEC Emerging Tech Conference 2026
events.description: A full-day showcase of new jobsite technology for contractors, with working groups, roundtables, workshops and case studies. Part of Boston Built Week 2026.

events.title: Developer Roundtable: Boston Built Week
events.description: An evening roundtable for people developing projects in Boston, covering financing, permitting, design and delivery. Limited to 80 attendees. Part of Boston Built Week 2026.

events.title: Offsite Construction Summit — Washington, DC
events.description: One-day regional summit on offsite delivery for housing, healthcare and data centers, with manufacturer exhibits and case-study presentations. Supported by the Modular Building Institute.

events.title: Passive House Building: Bunker Hill Housing Redevelopment Tour
events.organizer: Mass Clean Energy Center (MassCEC) and Passive House Massachusetts
events.description: A site tour of two buildings at the mixed-income Bunker Hill Housing Redevelopment in Charlestown, a large passive house certified residential project, with discussion led by project experts. Part of Boston Built Week 2026.

events.title: The Buildings Show / Construct Canada 2026
events.description: Canada's largest built-environment show, combining Construct Canada, PM Expo, HomeBuilder & Renovator Expo and the World of Concrete Toronto pavilion, with a large education program.

events.title: Offsite Construction Summit — Houston
events.description: Regional edition of the Offsite Construction Network's travelling summit, focused on offsite delivery for the Gulf Coast's industrial and infrastructure markets.

events.title: BAU 2027
events.description: Biennial world trade fair for architecture, materials and building systems; serial, modular and industrialized construction is a recurring theme.

events.title: PCI Convention at The Precast Show 2027
events.venue: Salt Lake Marriott Downtown at City Creek
events.description: Annual convention of the precast concrete industry, with technical committee meetings and education, co-located with NPCA's The Precast Show exhibit floor.

events.title: NAHB International Builders' Show (IBS) 2027
events.description: The largest annual light-construction show, held as part of Design & Construction Week with KBIS; includes sessions on offsite, panelized and factory-built housing.

events.title: BUILDEX Vancouver 2027 — Offsite Zone
events.description: Western Canada's building industry show, with a dedicated expo zone and conference stream on prefabrication, modular and offsite construction.

events.title: ULI Housing Opportunity Conference 2027
events.organizer: Urban Land Institute (ULI), Terwilliger Center for Housing
events.description: ULI's annual national housing conference for developers, lenders, investors, public officials, planners, architects and advocates, in Denver.

events.title: ACCE Construction Industry Forum 2027
events.description: Annual forum for construction educators and industry, held during the ACCE Midyear Conference. Theme: Building the Future: Technology, Talent, and Industry Partnership. Session 1 covers advancing industrialized construction education.

events.title: ASCE2027 (includes CI Summit 2027)
events.description: ASCE's combined infrastructure and engineering conference, which hosts the Construction Institute's 2027 summit.

events.title: International Mass Timber Conference 2027
events.organizer: International Mass Timber Conference / Trifecta Collective
events.description: The largest gathering of the mass timber supply chain — building tours, technical sessions and an expo covering CLT, glulam and prefabricated timber systems.

events.title: Smart Cities Connect Conference & Expo 2027
events.venue: John B. Hynes Veterans Memorial Convention Center
events.description: Conference and expo where city leaders and smart city technology providers meet. City staff attend free.

events.title: World of Modular 2027
events.description: MBI's annual convention and trade show for commercial modular and offsite construction: education, exhibit hall, awards and industry networking.

events.title: MHI Congress & Expo 2027
events.description: The manufactured housing industry's main annual meeting, with education on factory-built home design, production, finance and policy, plus an exhibit floor.

events.title: BuiltWorlds Chicago Global Summit 2027
events.description: BuiltWorlds' North American summit on AEC technology and capital, spanning its research tracks including offsite.

events.title: ENR FutureTech 2027
events.description: ENR's annual forum on construction technology that has been tested on real projects, with keynotes, panels, breakouts and live demos on a startup stage.

events.title: NIBS Building Innovation 2027
events.description: Annual NIBS conference convening federal, state and industry leaders on building science, housing innovation, industrialized construction and permitting.

events.title: UK Construction Week London 2027 — Offsite
events.description: UK Construction Week's London edition, with a dedicated offsite and modern methods of construction (MMC) section.

events.title: SAME Joint Engineer Training Conference & Expo (JETC) 2027
events.description: SAME's annual joint engineer training conference and expo, with 70+ education sessions, an exhibit hall and an executive panel with the engineer service chiefs.

events.title: AIA Conference on Architecture & Design 2027 (AIA27)
events.description: The AIA's national conference and expo (expo May 20–21), with continuing education for architects including sessions on prefabrication and design for manufacture.

events.title: Expo Construção Offsite 2027
events.description: Latin America's largest offsite and modular construction exhibition, with construction-system showcases and a lecture arena.

events.title: PCI Committee Days Conference 2027
events.description: PCI's technical committee week, where the institute's codes, standards and design-guidance committees meet in person.

events.title: SAME Federal Small Business Conference 2027
events.description: SAME's annual federal market research conference for architecture, engineering and construction firms, with federal agency leaders, prime contractors and small businesses.
